description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield tapped
When the basic land enters, Amulet of Vigor, Dal R'El, and Obuun trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the basic land.
Resolve the Dal R'El trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Obuun trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.
